name: manual_365e89
claim: To make a rollback visible to a consumer, make the confirming act itself a new event in the hash-chained log: after a restore the next event takes a version the consumer already holds with a different digest, with no clocks needed.

decisions.notes: 2026-10-19: modelled designs D0 (scalar floors), D1 (digest of existing event), D2 (finalization as chain event); only D2 refused the rollback that happens after the request and before the consumer commits.

rationale: 2026-10-19: modelled designs D0 (scalar floors), D1 (digest of existing event), D2 (finalization as chain event); only D2 refused the rollback that happens after the request and before the consumer commits.
